**Triage: `repo:objectui` · `pm:blocked` on #17250 · type Bug. ⛔ No `domain:*` — objectui's triage produces that once the card lands there.**

Per SKILL.md's lane table, `packages/console`'s **dist is script-generated (⛔ never hand-edited) and its UI defects go to `repo:objectui`**. Strip objectstack out of this report and it still stands ⇒ rule 1 puts the card in the repo its fix lands in.

⚠️ **It is labelled into the pending transfer batch rather than moved or rebuilt.** A seat cannot transfer an issue in this container (GraphQL refused outside a pinned PR-review set; REST has no transfer endpoint — measured this round), and **#17250 already carries a director-seat ruling (option A) plus a `Maintainer-action:` line** whose *"re-read `label:repo:objectui` first"* clause picks up cards added after its count. ⇒ ⛔ this seat does **not** rebuild it in objectui: rebuilding is the ruling's own **lossy fallback**, invoked by the maintainer replying 「重建」, ⛔ not by a seat deciding to.

`Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#17250` appended to the body as a machine-readable line.

### Why `priority:p1`

⭐ **The card names the stake plainly and it is the strongest severity claim in this batch:** *"This is the one that stops the consuming app being demonstrable at all"* — the blocked action is that product's **primary user action**. An action's `params` dialog renders a field-backed lookup as a **bare text input**: **0 options, no request on the wire**, so the action **cannot be launched from the UI at all**.

⇒ not a degraded experience — a dead path on the headline flow of a real consuming app, on 17.4.0, found by browser dogfood.

⚠️ **This p1 is currently sitting behind a pending maintainer action** (#17250's transfer). ⭐ That is named in this round's report to the maintainer, because a demo-blocking p1 waiting on a bookkeeping move is the wrong place for it to wait. ⛔ The seat does not resolve that by rebuilding the card unilaterally.

⚠️ Two siblings, each independently blocking the **same** action: #17271 (dialog has no internal scroll, Submit unreachable) and #17272 (file widget posts a blob where a `sys_file` id is wanted). ⇒ **all three must land before that action works** — ⛔ fixing one does not unblock the flow, and whoever takes any of them should say so.

## Moved to objectstack-ai/objectui#10129 — closing `duplicate`

Triage seat (`session_01KYzNJPin9Ar4oMMkSh4S9h`), 2026-09-20T12:54Z. Executing the letter-**A** ruling on #17250 (「issue 住在修复落地的仓」) under the maintainer's 2026-09-20 approval of the hybrid split.

**Nothing here is declined.** The work continues at **objectstack-ai/objectui#10129**, which carries this card's full text, its grade and its type unchanged.

### Why recreated rather than transferred

GitHub's issue transfer exists only in GraphQL, and this container's egress refuses it: `POST https://api.github.com/graphql` answers **403** 「GitHub GraphQL is not available from Claude Code sessions」. The REST API has no transfer endpoint at all — `POST /repos/…/issues/…/transfer` answers **404**. Both measured this round, ⛔ not recalled. ⇒ `SKILL.md`〈多仓协调〉's fallback applies verbatim: 「transfer 不可用时重建:出处头 + 裸 `#N` 改全名 + 关源单为 moved」.

### ⛔ This thread is not lost

This card is **closed, not deleted** — everything written here stays readable at this URL, and the new card's body header points back to it by number. The move was priced on exactly that: of the 27 cards in the recreate batch, every carried comment was read first and all of them are PM routing/grading comments, ⛔ none is irreplaceable evidence. The six cards whose threads *do* carry evidence are being hand-transferred losslessly by the maintainer instead.

`state_reason: duplicate` ⇒ the new card is the same issue in the repo that owns it. ⚠️ GitHub's REST `PATCH /issues` accepts a `duplicate_of` field and then **silently ignores** it (200, field still null — measured twice), so the machine-readable pointer could not be set from this channel; **objectstack-ai/objectui#10129** is the pointer, in prose.
